@Capt_Rye
Best skill set for different ship types

Because of the rework of the skill tree asking for specific skill sets is really not the best solution for you as each skill offers a different impact on play style and your play style is not necessarily my play style. However that being said there are a couple of course skills that I feel every single captain in each class should have.

Destroyers: the absolute must haves in my opinion are; superintendent. Because having those extra smokescreens defensive fires or speed boost late in the game can mean the difference between surviving and winning or dying and losing. There have been many occasions as you can see in my YouTube videos or I come down to using all five of my premium consumables. Last Stand. Another one that is an absolute must for destroyers because you rely on your speed and Mobility to keep you alive. Having your engine knocked out and being stuck in the middle of your smokescreen or and the open makes you a sitting Target for other destroyers, Cruisers, carriers and even battleships. While it may only give you half capacity to the modules knocked out it's still better than being dead in the water or stuck turning in a Circle. Concealment expert. Again going with the fact that you were stealth capability is your survivability. Being able to sneak up onto an enemy and detecting them at the same time or before they detect you could be the difference between surviving and engagement and being the first dead in the game. As for other skills there more Nation specific. Survivability expert on US destroyers and German Destroyers. Torpedo reload on German and Japanese Destroyers. Advanced firing training on Russian and US destroyers. Demolitions expert on Russian Destroyers.

Cruisers: the absolute must haves for Cruiser captains;

Expert Marksman. You are a maneuverable ship and you need to have your guns be able to keep up with your maneuvering. You also want to be able to keep track of small fast targets like destroyers as they will be some of your primary prey. Basic and advanced firing training. Your Cruiser secondary Armament is not nearly as good as a battleships however it does serve as powerful antiaircraft and being able to shoot down airplanes and provide coverage for your larger Capital ships and small destroyers can make all the difference when dealing with a confident CV player. It will also boost the range and rate of fire of your secondaries and can punish enemy destroyers you get a little too close. Superintendent. Again having those extra consumables for, heals on high-tier Cruisers, hydros, Radars, and Scout Fighters may make all the difference in late game play and tactics. And finally concealment expert. The not as important on Cruisers it can help serve a vital purpose. Not being detected from longer ranges means you can be safer from battleships but it also means that you can positively identify when a destroyer is within your radar range(10km usually). You can then activate hydroacoustic, radar or Scout Fighter to try and spot the enemy Destroyer or notify your team that there is one within 10 kilometers.

Battleships: the absolute must haves for Battleship captains;

Expert Marksman. You have slow traversing guns anything helps to get them on the target quicker. Superintendent. Like the previous ships having that extra consumable is an absolute necessity for surviving through to the end and late game. I cannot tell you the number of times having one extra heel has saved me and earned me a dreadnought instead of sending me to the bottom. Advanced firing training. This will boost your antiaircraft defenses when dealing with high tier carriers it will also boost the overall range of your secondary batteries which means cheeky destroyers that decided to come in for suicide runs are going to pay the price for their away from you giving you time to react. Manual secondaries. Well best used on German battleships manual secondaries are absolutely devastating regardless of the nation. Most battleships carry a secondary Armament equivalent to that of a light Cruiser at Tier 6 or Tier 7. Combined with the above skill and module most high tier BBs have secondary ranges of 7km-11km. Making enemy destroyers think twice about getting close enough to guarantee a torpedo it on you without risking a lot of damage or death to themselves.

Carriers: there are several carrier-specific skills. However I don't play carriers enough to know which skills are absolute necessities. The few that I dunno reduce the arm in time allowing you to get your planes back in the air faster. One skill will allow you to launch your aircraft when your flight deck is engulfed in flames. Four Japanese carriers with torpedo bombers you want the torpedo reload expert as it reduces your rearmament time on your planes by 20%.

As for the skill RPF. It would most likely be used on a cruiser that's going to survive to the end of the game and go hunting the lone surviving Destroyer. However if you are a competent player and you pay attention to your mini-map and chat log you can usually determine the location and distance of the enemy Destroyer. If you remain vigilant and continually change your course and speed you can almost always avoid the majority of torpedoes.

I hope this is sufficient information for you. And thanks for your support on my channel.
